title: Lambda Error Pattern Classification Guide
description: Match Lambda CloudWatch log error messages to determine the error pattern and appropriate remediation

patterns.explanation: Force cold start by updating env vars. If timeout recurs, increase timeout limit.
patterns.follow_up: If timeout recurs 3+ times, increase function timeout and check for slow external calls

patterns.explanation: Force cold start. Memory increase to fix permanently requires human approval.
patterns.follow_up: Human should increase memory size from current setting to 2x

patterns.explanation: Transient dependency failure. Cold start gets a new container with fresh connections.
patterns.follow_up: Check downstream service health if error recurs

patterns.explanation: Code-level bug. Restart will not fix it. Rollback to previous version required.
patterns.follow_up: Rollback Lambda alias to previous stable version

patterns.explanation: Concurrency limit reached. Need to request limit increase from AWS or add SQS queue.
patterns.follow_up: Request Lambda concurrency limit increase via AWS Support

patterns.explanation: IAM permission missing. Must be fixed by adding the required permission to the role.
patterns.follow_up: Add missing IAM permission to Lambda execution role
